facts.text: Ransom Canyon is based on a real novel series by Jodi Thomas, adapted for Netflix by showrunner April Blair (premiered April 17, 2025) — the show follows three ranching dynasties fighting over land, legacy, and each other in Texas Hill Country.

Season 2 premiered July 23, 2026 with all 8 episodes dropping at once — but Netflix canceled the series in September 2026 after two seasons, so the story is now complete at 18 total episodes, no more coming.
A real breakout hit for Netflix — the show spent four weeks in the platform's global Top 10 and charted in 77 countries.

Author Jodi Thomas says she genuinely "loves" what showrunner April Blair changed from her books — Blair added new subplots and twists and paced the central Quinn/Staten romance differently (they don't get together until Episode 7, during a tornado, unlike the first novel).

Season 2 raises the stakes on the central will-they-won't-they: Patricia Clarkson joins as Quinn's mother, and Ben Robson plays Oliver, a new love interest Quinn met in New York — six months after she left Staten (Josh Duhamel) and her hometown behind to chase her music career.
